name: noahjefferson-hub
description: Tooling for the noahjefferson.pages.dev link hub. The deployed site is public/ and has no build step; these scripts render images and run the accessibility audit.

scripts.check: node lessons-check.mjs && node docs-check.mjs . && node pin-check.mjs && npm run --silent security && node a11y-gate.mjs && node palette-check.mjs palettes/families.json
scripts.security: test -x .zizmor/bin/zizmor || { echo "zizmor is not installed. Run: npm run security:install"; exit 1; }; ./.zizmor/bin/zizmor --offline --strict-collection .github/workflows/
